title: Fix CI lint: prettier formatting after package renames
description:
CI 25501293195 lint job failed with 9 prettier/prettier errors caused by the recent ig→meta and free→free-media-upload renames. The longer names pushed several lines past the column limit; prettier wants them wrapped. 8 of 9 errors are auto-fixable.

Failing files (per CI log):
- packages/provider/free-media-upload/* — FreeMediaUploadHost, UploadToAnyHostRequest, FreeMediaUploadOptions
- packages/provider/meta/* — MetaMediaCreateRequestSchema, MetaMediaPublishRequestSchema
- a top-level test referencing 'packages/provider/free-media-upload/src'

Plus one parser-config error: 'parserOptions.project has been provided for @typescript-eslint/parser' at the top of the lint output. That MAY auto-resolve once the prettier errors clear, or it may indicate an eslint config that lost a tsconfig include after the directory renames — investigate after running --fix.

**Steps:**

1. cd /Users/jwt/apicity
2. Run: pnpm install (if node_modules missing)
3. Run: pnpm run lint --fix  (or pnpm prettier --write . — check repo scripts in package.json)
4. Re-run: pnpm run lint  — must pass with 0 errors
5. If the parserOptions.project error persists after step 4, investigate eslint config (likely .eslintrc.* or eslint.config.*) — look for any 'project' path that referenced 'packages/provider/ig' or 'packages/provider/free' (now renamed) and update it.
6. Run: pnpm run build  — verify nothing else broke
7. Run: pnpm run test:run (or whatever the test command is) — verify
8. Commit: 'fix(lint): prettier auto-fix after package renames'
9. Close this bead and let the publish step push.

Reference: failed CI run https://github.com/justintanner/apicity/actions/runs/25501293195

title: Fix CI: revert over-renamed CostSource literal in cost package
description:
CI is failing the typecheck for @apicity/cost with:

  src/compute.ts(169,9): error TS2322: Type '"free-media-upload"' is not assignable to type 'CostSource'.

Recent CI runs that failed: 25500404033, 25487630731, 25487463926, 25486968004 (and earlier). All same error.

Root cause: the package rename ig→meta / free→free-media-upload over-renamed in packages/provider/cost/src/compute.ts. Line 169 is:

  source: "free-media-upload",

This is semantically wrong. The 'free' literal at that position refers to the **CostSource** type (defined in src/types.ts as 'tokens-heuristic+table' | 'per-unit-table' | 'free'), NOT to the @apicity/free-media-upload package name. The CostSource 'free' tag means 'cost is zero / no metered source'.

The case discriminator at line 165 (case "free-media-upload":) IS correctly the renamed package, but the source: literal inside the return object is a different thing — a cost-source tag.

**Fix:**

In /Users/jwt/apicity/packages/provider/cost/src/compute.ts line 169, change:

  source: "free-media-upload",

to:

  source: "free",

That single-line revert makes the type-check pass.

**Verification (you must do all of these before closing):**

1. cd to /Users/jwt/apicity
2. Install deps if needed: pnpm install
3. Run the cost build: pnpm --filter @apicity/cost run build  (or pnpm --filter @apicity/cost run typecheck)  — must succeed
4. Run the full test suite: pnpm test  (or whatever the repo's test command is — check package.json scripts)  — all tests must pass
5. Only after both pass locally, close this bead

If after step 3 you discover OTHER similar over-renames (string literals where 'free' / 'ig' meant something other than the package name), audit and fix those too. Quick check: 'grep -rn "free-media-upload\|meta" packages/provider/cost/src/' will show all current uses; any literal that's used as a TYPE TAG (not as a package name) needs to revert to its pre-rename value.

Commit message style: 'fix(cost): revert over-renamed CostSource literal'.

After your push lands, I will check the next CI run on origin/main.
notes: Done: Reverted over-renamed CostSource literal 'free-media-upload' back to 'free' in compute.ts, and fixed the matching test expectation in cost-estimate.test.ts. Build and all 2443 tests pass.

title: Fix meta-post-video host (catbox→litterbox/anyHost) and record remaining meta HAR fixtures
description:
Fill the two remaining meta HAR-recording gaps from ac-70m.

PROBLEM:
- meta-post-video.test.ts step 1 uploads jump.mp4 via host.catbox.upload(...). Catbox now returns 412 'Invalid uploader' for anonymous uploads, so recording fails.
- meta-media-publish.test.ts needs a real, processed-but-not-yet-published IG container ID (env IG_TEST_CONTAINER_ID). The previous attempt left a container in ERROR state because the video URL was fake.

SCOPE:

Step 1 — Switch host in meta-post-video.test.ts (the only file change in src):
   Open /Users/jwt/apicity/tests/integration/meta-post-video.test.ts.
   Around line 45-50 change:
     const videoUrl = await host.catbox.upload({ file: blob, filename: 'jump.mp4' });
   to use uploadToAnyHost with a resilient host list:
     const videoUrl = await host.uploadToAnyHost({
       file: blob,
       filename: 'jump.mp4',
       hosts: ['litterbox', 'uguu', 'tflink'],
     });
   (FreeMediaUploadHost type already permits these three.) Update the comment on the prior line to reflect the new host strategy.

Step 2 — Re-record meta-post-video:
   cd /Users/jwt/apicity
   IG_CLIENT_ID=$(op item get IG_CLIENT_ID --vault apicity --reveal --fields password) \
   IG_CLIENT_SECRET=$(op item get IG_CLIENT_SECRET --vault apicity --reveal --fields password) \
   IG_ACCESS_TOKEN=$(op item get IG_ACCESS_TOKEN --vault apicity --reveal --fields password) \
   IG_USER_ID=$(op item get IG_USER_ID --vault apicity --reveal --fields password) \
     POLLY_MODE=record-missing \
     pnpm vitest run --config tests/vitest.integration.ts \
     tests/integration/meta-post-video.test.ts

   Confirm tests/recordings/meta_*/post-video_* directory now exists with a recording.har.

Step 3 — Attempt meta-media-publish:
   This test needs a fresh container ID. The just-recorded post-video flow publishes its own container, so its ID is unusable. Strategy:
   1. Write a tiny one-shot script (NOT committed) that uploads jump.mp4 via uploadToAnyHost, calls provider.post.v25.media(...) to create a REELS container, polls until status_code=FINISHED, then prints the container ID (DON'T publish).
   2. Export IG_TEST_CONTAINER_ID=<that-id> and run:
      POLLY_MODE=record-missing pnpm vitest run --config tests/vitest.integration.ts tests/integration/meta-media-publish.test.ts
   3. Commit the recording. Discard the throwaway script.

   If step 3 fails (rate limit, container error, time pressure, etc.) — DO NOT block. Document the failure in your bead-close notes and ship steps 1-2.

Step 4 — Verify replay-mode green:
   POLLY_MODE=replay pnpm vitest run --config tests/vitest.integration.ts tests/integration/meta-*.test.ts
   All four meta tests must pass with no env vars exported (pure replay).

Step 5 — Secret scrub:
   grep -rE 'Bearer |access_token=|IG_ACCESS_TOKEN' tests/recordings/meta_*/ | head
   Polly's redactor should have stripped these. Spot-check; manually scrub if needed.

Step 6 — Commit + publish step pushes:
   git add tests/integration/meta-post-video.test.ts tests/recordings/meta_*
   git commit -m 'test(meta): switch upload host to uploadToAnyHost, record remaining HAR fixtures'

Reference: prior recording bead ac-70m closed at commit 03cd954.

title: Lazy-load harness report by git commit
description:
Refactor tests/harness-report.ts so the generated harness HTML is split per git commit on the PR branch (base..HEAD), with each commit's HAR data lazy-fetched as a separate JSON file when navigated.

- meta-media-create.test.ts
- meta-media-publish.test.ts
- meta-post-video.test.ts (end-to-end: upload → create → poll → publish)

**Steps:**

1. cd /Users/jwt/apicity

2. Make sure 1Password CLI is unlocked. If not, the env-var subshells below will prompt. The agent runs in the same shell as the mayor, so 'op' should already be authenticated.

3. Pre-record sanity check — confirm the four creds are reachable:
   for k in IG_CLIENT_ID IG_CLIENT_SECRET IG_ACCESS_TOKEN IG_USER_ID; do
     echo "$k length: $(op item get $k --vault apicity --reveal --fields password 2>/dev/null | wc -c)"
   done
   All four should print non-zero lengths.

4. Run the recordings:
   IG_CLIENT_ID=$(op item get IG_CLIENT_ID --vault apicity --reveal --fields password) \
   IG_CLIENT_SECRET=$(op item get IG_CLIENT_SECRET --vault apicity --reveal --fields password) \
   IG_ACCESS_TOKEN=$(op item get IG_ACCESS_TOKEN --vault apicity --reveal --fields password) \
   IG_USER_ID=$(op item get IG_USER_ID --vault apicity --reveal --fields password) \
     POLLY_MODE=record-missing \
     pnpm vitest run --config tests/vitest.integration.ts tests/integration/meta-*.test.ts

   POLLY_MODE=record-missing means: replay if a recording exists, record if missing. Safe for re-runs.

5. Verify recordings landed:
   ls tests/recordings/meta_* 2>/dev/null
   # Should show 4 directories (one per test) with subdirectories per endpoint and recording.har files inside.

6. Re-run in default replay mode to confirm CI can replay them:
   pnpm vitest run --config tests/vitest.integration.ts tests/integration/meta-*.test.ts
   All four tests must pass with no env vars (pure replay).

7. Inspect the HAR files for any leaked secrets:
   grep -r 'Bearer\|access_token\|IG_ACCESS_TOKEN' tests/recordings/meta_*/ 2>/dev/null | head
   Polly's redactor (configured in tests/harness.ts) should have stripped Authorization and x-api-key. Spot-check that the access_token query parameter in URLs is also redacted — if not, manually scrub before committing.

8. Commit + the publish step pushes:
   git add tests/recordings/meta_*
   git commit -m 'test(meta): record HAR fixtures for content publish flow'
   # mol-publish-work's publish step takes care of pull --rebase + push.

**If any test fails to record (network error, scope error, etc):**

Don't force-record bogus fixtures. Note which test failed and why in the bead's close notes; mayor will troubleshoot live. Tests that DID record should still be committed.

**Do NOT modify the test source files.** They already use setupPolly + recordingExists and are correct as-written. Only commit the recording.har files.
